lessons.trigger_condition: tablet/mobile UI modernization without breaking existing product topology
lessons.symptom_summary: layout and touch ergonomics can improve while preserving 8 categories, 18 shortcuts, and 6 tablet-management functions
lessons.fix_pattern: use additive responsive card/grid styling, >=44px touch targets, status semantics, safe-area support, and preserve 8/18/6 structure

lessons.trigger_condition: persistent tablet/mobile navigation and PWA service-worker updates
lessons.symptom_summary: bottom navigation, aria semantics, reduced-motion, and stale service-worker state must remain coherent
lessons.fix_pattern: persistent dock with aria-current=location/aria-controls, reduced-motion-aware scrolling, guarded SW registration, explicit SW update generation

lessons.trigger_condition: tests assume all UI/cache-buster/component version numbers must be numerically identical
lessons.symptom_summary: independent semantic version domains can be falsely flagged as stale even when runtime contracts are coherent
lessons.fix_pattern: validate semantic authority and minimum/no-regression constraints instead of blindly synchronizing unrelated version labels

lessons.trigger_condition: server, maintenance, or manual paths invoke learning concurrently
lessons.symptom_summary: temporary global training-file patches and load-modify-save sequences can overlap across processes
lessons.fix_pattern: protect the complete learning transaction with the repository exclusive file-lock convention and restore temporary patches in finally blocks

lessons.trigger_condition: two learners load the same old state then save in different orders
lessons.symptom_summary: atomic writes prevent corruption but do not prevent one process from erasing another process learning
lessons.fix_pattern: use cross-process locking plus base/local/disk delta merge across the whole load-modify-save transaction

lessons.trigger_condition: malformed NaN/Inf inputs or concurrent neural retraining
lessons.symptom_summary: non-finite inputs can poison observations and an older training snapshot can overwrite a newer model if it finishes later
lessons.fix_pattern: safe finite/bounded coercion, fail-closed corrupted metadata handling, and model-scoped cross-process training locks

lessons.trigger_condition: persistent IDs use Python hash() or meta learners update shared state concurrently
lessons.symptom_summary: identical signals can receive different IDs between processes and stale meta writers can erase accumulated runs/context/source state
lessons.fix_pattern: derive persistent IDs from deterministic SHA-256 and serialize/merge complete meta-learning transactions across processes

lessons.trigger_condition: tablet, server, scheduled collection, and manual collection update health state concurrently
lessons.symptom_summary: consecutive failures, recent success timestamps, and precollect state can overwrite each other
lessons.fix_pattern: lock the entire runtime-health mutation, normalize malformed state fail-safe, and directly execute the relevant regression modules in CI

lessons.trigger_condition: tests match exact whitespace/source formatting rather than runtime semantics
lessons.symptom_summary: valid ai_models wiring and fail-soft behavior can be falsely reported as broken after harmless formatting changes
lessons.fix_pattern: normalize formatting or assert semantic/runtime behavior while preserving the original safety contract

lessons.trigger_condition: AI model files remain unchanged across freshness boundary or automation updates tracked JSON without regenerating integrity manifest
lessons.symptom_summary: tablet status can retain stale AI-active state and data automation can leave repository integrity metadata behind the actual snapshot
lessons.fix_pattern: bound AI-status cache TTL and freshness boundary, deep-copy cached state, fail-closed validator exceptions, regenerate+diagnose integrity manifest in the same publish commit, and reserve manual user evidence under candidate caps without auto-promotion

lessons.trigger_condition: worktree updates while an older tablet server process remains bound to the runtime port or health payload omits required collection-health evidence
lessons.symptom_summary: an old process can appear current when only disk Git state is checked, and missing collection health can otherwise fail open
lessons.fix_pattern: capture the server startup Git SHA once, expose it in health, exact-match runtime build SHA to disk HEAD, fail closed on missing/invalid collection health, and preserve only the explicit starting grace state

lessons.trigger_condition: server/manual verified learning and a separate RAW slab watcher write the same learning store concurrently or persisted metadata is malformed
lessons.symptom_summary: stale writers can lose samples, proxy rows can overwrite genuine RAW evidence, and malformed version strings can halt otherwise valid learning writes
lessons.fix_pattern: route every production writer and calibration rebuild through one re-entrant cross-process transaction, re-read latest state under the lock, protect source-blank genuine RAW rows, and bounded-recover malformed version metadata

lessons.trigger_condition: tablet server, manual verifier, and RAW watcher concurrently load-modify-save the manual graded-photo registry
lessons.symptom_summary: a stale last writer can erase another process registration or verification update even when each write is atomic
lessons.fix_pattern: preserve existing whole-transaction with-LOCK call sites but implement the outermost lock as a re-entrant thread lock backed by an adjacent cross-process exclusive file lock; verify with real two-process contention and lock cleanup
